notes.title: Everlasting Flowers - Next game by Sprite will release soon!
notes.notes:
We're excited to share some fantastic news from our friends at Sprite! Their upcoming game, Everlasting Flowers, is set to launch on Steam on August 29, 2024!

Everlasting Flowers® is the debut title in a captivating series of "cinematic novels" that follows the journey of two girls, Mina and Ran. Through their story, you'll explore their challenges and personal growth as they navigate their unique paths in life.

Be sure to visit their store page and add the game to your wishlist if you're intrigued by this heartfelt narrative!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2795270/Everlasting_Flowers__Where_there_is_a_will_there_is_a_way/

notes.title: HELLO LADY! RELEASE NEXT WEEK!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Are you excited already for our next game?
This time it's our first visual novel made by AKATSUKI-WORKS!

"It's the Dawn of a New Age-

The 21st century has brought about its own slew of problems for society at large.
As a result, the most promising youths from around the world have been gathered and enrolled in Amakawa Noble Academy. The curriculum at The Academy is designed to teach students how to use their talents to lead humanity toward a brighter future."

Standing at the apex of Amakawa Noble Academy are five beautiful young girls known as "Crowns."

notes.title: PATCH 1.1 & STEAM AUTUMN SALE
notes.notes:
Hey people! 
We just released patch 1.1 for Aokana and the Steam Autumn Sale is currently live!

 Added Voice line Bookmarks
 Added asset prefetch for a better reading experience
 Added multithreading
 Added various performance improvements
 Fixed several bugs and typos


You can find the Voice line bookmark button ingame at the top of the menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35262642/0bf87077a0bb411aee3bc6cc0ae62febba9880c0.jpg

Clicking it will bring up the extra menu where you will be able to save the voice line.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35262642/af08d6e12e00894e0fe15f78b9cb29bcd502d4fd.jpg

You can always open the extra menu from the main menu by clicking on "Extra."
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35262642/7cce120fc63dc84417464b54e7645988da34af80.jpg

Also, the Steam Autumn Sale is currently live and our whole catalog of games is discounted right now so take a look!

notes.title: Aokana Release Date - 27th of September
notes.notes:
It’s been a while since we last updated you guys about what’s going on with Aokana.
We are happy to announce that Aokana was approved by Valve and will be released at the end of this month, on the 27th of September!

Also, you can still order physical goodies on the Aokana Backerkit at https://aokana.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders
The Backerkit will close on the 25th of September.
